name: CSN 302 雷暴绕飞 TCAS机动 备降/返航

cards.audioText: Your call sign is CSN 302, you are at parking bay 235, you are ready for pushback, contact Guangzhou Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 CSN 302，你位于 235 停机位，已准备好推出，联系广州地面。
cards.referenceText: Ground, CSN 302, Bay 235, ready for pushback. I request pushback
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州地面，CSN 302，235 停机位，已准备好推出。我请求推出。

cards.audioText: CSN 302, stand by, expect 20 minutes delay, thunderstorm is approaching the airport, numerous aircraft holding for weather improvement.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 302，等待，预计延误 20 分钟，雷暴正在接近机场，许多航空器正在等待天气改善。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 302, report tug is ready.
B: Tell the controller the tug is in position and you are ready for pushback.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： CSN 302，报告牵引车是否准备好。
B： 告诉管制员牵引车已就位，你已准备好推出。
cards.referenceText: The tug, ready, ready for pushback request pushback, CSN 302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 牵引车已准备好，已准备好推出，请求推出，CSN 302。

cards.audioText: CSN 302, pushback approved, facing east, Runway 19, stand by for startup.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 302，推出批准，机头朝东，Runway 19，等待开车。
cards.referenceText: pushback approved, facing east, Runway 19, stand by startup, CSN 302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出批准，机头朝东，Runway 19，等待开车，CSN 302。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have been waiting for the start of clearance for about 15 minutes, contact Guangzhou Ground for start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已等待开车许可约 15 分钟，联系广州地面请求开车。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Ground, CSN 302, we have been waiting for about 15 minutes, request start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州地面，CSN 302，我们已等待约 15 分钟，请求开车。

cards.audioText: CSN 302, expect departure at 49, start up at own discretion, QNH 1008, report when ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 302，预计 49 时离场，自主决定开车，QNH 1008，准备好滑行时报告。
cards.referenceText: start up at own discretion, QNH 1008, CSN 302.

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for taxi.
CSN 302, taxi via J, D, T3 and T4 to holding point Runway 19.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 302，经 J、D、T3 和 T4 滑行至 Runway 19 等待点。
cards.referenceText: taxi via J, DAL, T tree, T four, to holding point Runway 19, CSN 302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 J、DAL、T3、T4 滑行至 Runway 19 等待点，CSN 302。

cards.audioText: CSN 302, hold short of T3, give way to Airbus 3 20 crossing from right to left.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 302，在 T3 前等待，给从右向左穿越的 Airbus 320 让行。
cards.referenceText: hold short of T3, give way to Airbus 3 20, CSN 302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在 T3 前等待，给 Airbus 320 让行，CSN 302。

cards.audioText: CSN 302, traffic is clear, continue taxi via D, T3 and T4 to holding point Runway 19.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 302，相关航空器已通过，经 D、T3 和 T4 继续滑行至 Runway 19 等待点。
cards.referenceText: continue taxi via DAL, T tree, T four, holding point Runway 19, CSN 302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 DAL、T3、T4 继续滑行至 Runway 19 等待点，CSN 302。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are holding point F1, Runway 19, you are fully ready, contact Guangzhou Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 F1、跑道 19 等待点，完全准备好，联系广州塔台。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN 302, holding point F1, Runway 19, fully ready.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，CSN 302，F1 等待点，跑道 19，完全准备好。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 302, line up and wait Runway 19, caution thunderstorm building up at the departure end of Runway 19.
B: Read back ATC clearance and request right turn when airborne due weather.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： CSN 302，进入 Runway 19 等待，注意 Runway 19 离场端有雷暴发展。
B： 复诵 ATC 许可，并因天气原因请求离地后右转。
cards.referenceText: line up and wait Runway 19, request right turn due weather, CSN 302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进入 Runway 19 等待，因天气原因请求右转，CSN 302。

cards.audioText: CSN 302, turn right heading 120, direct to LMN, Runway 19, cleared for takeoff, surface wind 180 degrees, 5 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 302，右转航向 120，直飞 LMN，Runway 19，许可起飞，地面风向 180 度，风速 5 米/秒。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 120, direct to LM November, Runway 19, cleared for takeoff, CSN 302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 120，直飞 LMN，Runway 19，许可起飞，CSN 302。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, maintaining 2100 meters, heading 120, contact Guangzhou Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离地，保持 2100 米，航向 120，联系广州进近。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Approach, CSN 302, airborne, maintaining 2100 meters, heading 120.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州进近，CSN 302，已离地，保持 2100 米，航向 120。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 302, climb to 2700 meters on QNH 1008.
cards.referenceText: Climb to 2700 meters on QNH 1008, CSN 302.

cards.audioText: B: During climb, suddenly you have been struck by foreign object, possibly hail strike, your instruments are indicating incorrectly, report it to Guangzhou Approach and request return to land.
cards.audioTextZh: B：爬升中，你突然被外来物击中，可能是冰雹撞击，仪表指示不正确，向广州进近报告并请求返回着陆。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Approach, CSN 302, we have been struck by foreign object, possibly hail strike, our instruments are indicating incorrectly, request return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州进近，CSN 302，我们被外来物击中，可能是冰雹撞击，仪表指示不正确，请求返回着陆。

cards.audioText: CSN 302, roger, descend to 1500 meters, expect radar vector for final Runway 19.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 302，收到，下降至 1500 米，预计雷达引导 Runway 19 五边。
cards.referenceText: descend to 1500 meters, radar vector for final Runway 19, CSN 302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 1500 米，雷达引导 Runway 19 五边，CSN 302。
